## Company

eventech is an AI & automation studio based in San Francisco, California.
Founded in 2026 by Sofiane Moudjahed.

eventech helps companies:
- automate operations
- launch AI-native products
- build custom AI systems

eventech works on fixed-scope engagements and typically ships projects in 2–6 weeks.

## Services

### AI & Automation
AI agents and workflow automation for inbox triage, ticket handling, CRM updates,
approval routing, reporting, and tool integrations.
https://eventech.cloud/services/ai-automation-for-operations.html

### AI Products & Apps
AI-native marketing sites, SaaS products, and internal tools, designed and shipped
end-to-end.
https://eventech.cloud/services/ai-product-development.html

### Custom AI Systems
Custom retrieval systems, fine-tuning workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and
private/VPC deployments.
https://eventech.cloud/services/custom-ai-systems.html
